verdict.rationale: Zamzar documents that files have an expiry point and that users can delete them before it, and its API workflow can remove files from Zamzar's servers. The evidence never states how long uploads or converted files are actually kept, so the retention policy is only implied. missing for 10: stated retention duration for uploaded files, stated deletion timing for converted outputs, per-plan retention differences, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, a hosted converter documents how long uploads are kept and when converted files are deleted

citations.quote: All users can delete files sooner than the expiry point for their file
